simple.meaning: אֱנָשׁ (ʼĕnâsh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a man.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H606. enash אֱנָשׁ noun masculine man, mankind ; — absolute ׳א Dan 2:10 +; emphatic אֲנָשָׁא 2:38 +, so Qr 4:13 ; 4:14 ( > Kt אנושׁא K § 57f ); so Nabataean אנוש often Lzb 222 Cooke 219 SAC 22 ): plural אֲנָשָׁים 4:14 (Hebraism, M 53* proposes אֲנָשָׁא ); — 1 man , human being, Dan 2:10 ; 3:10 ; 4:13 ; 5:5 , 7 (twice in verse); 6:13 (twice in verse); 7:4 (twice in verse); 7:8 ; Ezra 6:11 ; so בַּראֱֿנָשׁ Dan 7:13 a son of man , human being (see especially Dr Dan 102; DB SON OF MAN ). 2 collective men, people , Ezra 4:11 ; Dan 4:14 a; 4:22 (twice in verse); 4:29 (twice in verse); 4:30 ; 5:21 , compare plural 4:14 ; א ׳ןְרַע 2:43 i.e. human offspring; אֲנָשָׁא בְּנֵי sons of men , = men, 2:38 ; 5:21 .
